title: Astral experience on 'the hill' after Zoom call with a Telepathy Tapes guest, linked through Ken from Baker Victory

tellings.quote: they were showing me an image of um, a kid named Ken that was in the program that I was in at Baker Victory who was a non-verbal autistic

plain: After a Zoom call with a guest from The Telepathy Tapes, a podcast about nonverbal autistic people said to communicate by telepathy, Jordan Jose went out of his body to a place he calls "the hill", where unnamed beings showed him an image of Ken, a nonverbal autistic boy who had been in the same program as him at a place called Baker Victory. Jose, who says the government took him into a UFO program as a child, tells Michels this happened to him. If true, it would tie the boys of that childhood program together through some kind of mind-to-mind contact.
